recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-25406 unless PA later reopens broader OrganizationAffiliation directional modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-25406 was a Published PA change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify the difference between OrganizationAffiliation.organization and OrganizationAffiliation.participatingOrganization using improved element descriptions, comments, and examples.
initial_application: Commit a37fa0b2e9079345bb47dbfc13a882588486fd6a applied the issue by adding the requested examples to source/organizationaffiliation/organizationaffiliation-introduction.xml and adding the organization comment plus participatingOrganization cross-reference comment to source/organizationaffiliation/structuredefinition-OrganizationAffiliation.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes organizationaffiliation as a current resource. Later source history for the affected element lines did not reverse the clarification. PA minutes record that wording still needed work in 2021 and that PA voted 4-0-0 in 2022 to make several FHIR-25406 updates. A reviewed Zulip OrganizationAffiliation thread discusses adjacent modeling questions but does not conflict with the current directional interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative StructureDefinition identifies organization as the primary organization where the role is available, identifies participatingOrganization as performing the coded role to the Primary Organization, and points to shared examples. The narrative Scope and Usage page also includes the supplier and member examples from the Jira resolution.

related_jiras.note: A later OrganizationAffiliation.network clarification touched neighboring source but did not alter the organization/participatingOrganization distinction.
